from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper with its outgoing references and incoming citations from the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper references in its bibliography")
    cited_by_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper in their bibliographies")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
